judgment.notes: H006 is instantiated at t0/2 and 3t0/2, which satisfy its strict positive-time conditions. Finite-dimensional compactness, smooth calculus and Lebesgue-integrability facts apply with the actual compact C, positive R, smooth u and continuous supported scalar fields (BG001–BG004). There are no external applications.

S001–S002 construct the required uniform support and containing open box. S003 proves derivative vanishing on the open complement times int J and joint continuity, including that of e_t and the differentiated product. S004 bounds each absolute value by a finite constant times 1_Q, proving absolute integrability without interchanging any derivative and integral. S005 uses t0∈int J and generalizes to every positive time, retaining the same witnesses for each interval. All N002 clauses follow.
